note: Three passages over the tuner's own sample photograph, and the project the deployed page opens on. The sky is a van Gogh: a starry flow with three swirl centres placed by hand, a fauve palette and Starry Night's colours transferred onto it. The foreground is hatched in the manner of Cezanne, on an impressionist palette turned towards gold, with The Great Wave's colours. Between them the cliff is left on the base grade -- a waterlily weave under Water Lilies' own colour -- so all three of flow, palette and reference are shown acting per passage AND globally at once. The mask was painted by hand at the photograph's own 1400x1054, so it lines up pixel for pixel; explode it back to an editable PNG with project.save_bundle.
